notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for timestamped object-deletion reconstitution when a joined owner resigns before the producer retracts the queued deletion. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies joined-owner cleanup, object identity restoration for surviving members, ownership boundary callbacks, and standard retraction metadata without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped DeleteObjectInstance, Retract, ownership, Resign, lookup, and lifecycle declarations with FederateAmbassador removal, retraction, ownership, and time-role callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped object-deletion, retraction, ownership, resignation, and lookup declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
